reason: Describes the Claude skill workflow that writes the user guide, not application behaviour. There is no app code path to assert; the guide's own traceability footers and status mode are the check.

scenario: saldo/Same saldo regardless of runtime timezone
reason: Comparing two runtime timezones needs two processes: Node caches the zone at startup, so a runtime TZ change has no effect. The suite is instead parameterized by TZ (jest.config.mjs pins a non-UTC zone; TZ=UTC npm run test:ci runs it again), and 'Begin date at the UTC day boundary' covers the mechanism that makes the result invariant.

scenario: data-load-performance/Layout and page read the same data
reason: React's per-request cache() only dedupes inside a real request scope. The Jest harness mocks cache() to an identity function so server modules can load under jsdom, so request-scoped memoization cannot be observed there.
Requires two separate request scopes to observe that memoization does not leak between them. Jest has no request boundary, and the e2e layer cannot see per-request query counts.

scenario: statistics/Same grouping regardless of runtime timezone
reason: Comparing two runtime timezones needs two processes: Node caches the zone at startup. The suite is parameterized by TZ instead (jest.config.mjs pins a non-UTC zone; TZ=UTC npm run test:ci runs it again), and 'Worklog near UTC midnight' asserts the UTC grouping that makes the figures invariant.

The requirement itself states this is enforced by code review, not tooling: no check can tell whether a test really asserts the scenario's THEN. The rule is written into CLAUDE.md and e2e/README.md, and the generated map puts each claim in the diff a reviewer reads.
